original: We are dominated by everything with which our self becomes identified. We can dominate and control everything from which we disidentify ourselves.
traduccion: Nos domina todo aquello con lo que nuestro yo se identifica. Podemos dominar y dirigir todo aquello de lo que nos desidentificamos.
